image_description.en: AgentDesk Booking Detail screen for the fictional booking NW-FAKE-100482 at the invented Verdant Quay Hotel, Aldermere Bay. The Booking summary panel at the top of the main column is highlighted with an orange ring around the green Booking status chip reading Confirmed; the callout to its right is labelled step 1. Below the chip the screen shows the booking reference NW-FAKE-100482, and the Stay and room panel shows check-in Thu 16 Apr 2026, check-out Sun 19 Apr 2026, three nights, and the room type Twin Deluxe Room. Click the status chip area to confirm the status before contacting the property. The whole screen carries the watermark FICTIONAL — SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA.
